query:
SELECT (SELECT title FROM media WHERE id = $1 AND "libraryId" = ANY($4)) AS title,
                  ($2::int IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_groups WHERE id = $2 AND "mediaId" = $1)) AS "season!",
                  ($3::int IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM items e WHERE e.id = $3 AND e."mediaId" = $1)) AS "episode!"
